title: Console eager chunk: GridField sits in ui-components although it is dynamically imported (static export + sideEffects); carve it out and lower the ceiling
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up owed by the maintainer's ruling 7063116595 on #36023 (option B: raise the eager `ui-components` ceiling by about 8 KB, in budget PR #36100, so #36039 can land; "a separate card follows to take GridField out of the eager chunk, after which the ceiling can come back down"). Evidence: the fable review `build-seat1/36023/S5/fable-budget.md` in the project folder.

## What happens

`GridField` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`, about 90 KB of source) is in the console's eager `ui-components` chunk. `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` imports it dynamically, but the same entry also exports it statically, and the package is `sideEffects: true`, so the dynamic import does nothing. The repo already lists it as an ineffective dynamic import (`ui/scripts/vite-ineffective-dynamic-imports.ts`). Also, `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` assigns every `packages/(components|fields)/` module to `ui-components` by path, so a lazy boundary alone saves nothing without a chunk group and a `PER_CHUNK_MEMBERSHIP_CARVE_OUTS` entry (precedent: `fields-date-picker`, objectui#12622). Main itself drifted about +5.4 KB on this line today, measured by #36100.

## To do

1. Measure GridField's in-chunk gzip size on main (two builds of one tree).
2. Take it out of the eager chunk: drop the static export or route it through the lazy path, add its chunk group and carve-out, and make sure the record form's line-item table shows no blank or flash on first render (a preload when the form mounts is one way; measure it).
3. Lower `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['ui-components']` and its baseline by what was taken out, in the file's own "Raising it" style with the rows published.

## Acceptance

- `ui-components` eager gzip drops by GridField's measured size, and the ceiling comes down with it.
- The line-item table in a create and an edit form renders on first open with no blank cell and no focus loss, pinned in an e2e.
